checks.text: With no image loaded, the page shows the heading "Image Cropper", the text "No image loaded", and a button labelled "Load image".
Clicking "Load image" opens a file picker; selecting a 400x300 PNG file named "test.png" displays the image on the canvas and shows the text "400 x 300 px" in the dimensions label.

After loading a 400x300 image, dragging the bottom-right handle of the crop box to create a 200x150 crop region and clicking the button "Apply crop" results in the canvas displaying an image with dimensions "200 x 150 px" in the dimensions label.

After loading a 400x300 image, typing "100" in the field labelled "Width" and "75" in the field labelled "Height" and clicking the button "Resize" results in the dimensions label showing "100 x 75 px".
After loading a 400x300 image, clicking the button "Rotate 90" changes the dimensions label to "300 x 400 px".
After loading a 400x300 image, clicking the button "Flip horizontal" does not change the dimensions label, which remains "400 x 300 px", but the image content is mirrored.
After loading a 400x300 image, selecting "Grayscale" in the select labelled "Filter" applies the filter and the select shows "Grayscale" as the selected value.
After loading a 400x300 image, clicking the button "Export PNG" triggers a download of a file named "cropped.png".

Reload keeps the loaded image and its current dimensions; after reloading the page with a previously loaded 400x300 image, the dimensions label still shows "400 x 300 px" and the canvas displays the image.
